issues: CC-wheel-metadata-001: B002 promises distribution, version, build, and tag components, while the declared signature and test require a three-tuple

issues.resolution: Choose and consistently specify either the three-value adapted result or a result that includes wheel tags.
Record upstream symbols or an explicit adapter derivation for every exported helper.
Add a behavior clause for urlsafe_b64encode and correct the split_sections test mapping.

notes: Normalization helpers are testable, but the headline filename contract is internally contradictory and several adapted endpoints lack provenance.
